'''bounty hunter6 i shall ehjoy watching you die''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 11 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Vile hunter6 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I need some REAL help with this deck so review it with lots of tips please

The published list has 55 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck is going to have enough air to hold 2 sites and maybe take down a hidden base deck. Oppenent will eventually have to deploy there (cuz they lose force everytime they dont have someone there)
Then I capture and bounty and jail em then take em out and feed them to the rancor or sarlacc. Depends who i got on table. I need lots of tips but still be careful with the ratings....
